memory_candidates.content: After a `rw` chain whose final rewrite leaves two sides equal only by unfolding non-reducible `def`s (e.g. a fixture-level `IsFwdPath` vs the abstract `IsPath (Rf 0)`), `rw`'s closing `rfl` (reducible transparency) does not fire; append `exact Iff.rfl` rather than restructuring the proof.

The typst-sync pre-commit gate (.githooks/pre-commit Check 2) fires on ANY staged .lean path, including specs/evidence probes outside FormalSystem/, and compares status.typ counts against the live tree -- so a foreign uncommitted FormalSystem edit blocks an unrelated probe commit. Do not --no-verify; retry after the other writer lands.
